title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction of Cases by Internet Courts

articles.content_en:
Article 2 For the civil disputes over contracts and other property rights and interests specified in Article 1 of these Provisions, the parties may, according to law, agree by agreement that the Internet Court of the place having actual connection with the dispute shall have jurisdiction.
Where the parties agree by way of standard terms that the case shall be under the jurisdiction of the Internet Court, such agreement shall comply with the provisions of laws and judicial interpretations on standard terms.

Article 3 Cases where a party appeals against a judgment or ruling made by an Internet Court shall be heard by the Intermediate People's Court of the place where the Internet Court is located. If there are several Intermediate People's Courts in such place, the case shall be heard by the Intermediate People's Court designated by the Higher People's Court.
If the appealed case falls within the jurisdiction of a special people's court, it shall be heard by the corresponding special people's court.

Article 4 These Provisions shall come into force as of November 1, 2025. Cases that have been accepted before the entry into force of these Provisions shall continue to be heard by the original accepting people's court.
If any previously issued judicial interpretation is inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.
